_comment: Copy to hosts.json (gitignored) and edit. This is the deploy inventory: the one place that
unit: the systemd unit name AS IT EXISTS ON THAT HOST. Backdrop is the one that varies —
and both exist on real installs. Check yours before the first deploy:
ssh: anything your SSH config accepts. Key auth is required — the deploy runs with
BatchMode=yes so it fails fast rather than hanging on a password prompt.
Omit 'ssh' to run a host's commands locally; that is what marks the workstation.
